svg.title: Previously, the origin story
svg.desc: A four-panel comic strip. Panel one: Khon Kaen, 2 a.m., a laptop reads accuracy 99.7 percent and the hero thinks: too good, suspicious. Panel two: the Seagate arc, a manufacturing internship next to a spinning platter. Panel three: one week ago, the arc is complete and a hard drive sidekick follows the hero home. Panel four: Season 2 begins.

g.text: real data, real platters at 7,200 RPM.
